stem: Write 12.5% as a fraction in lowest terms.
hints: 12.5/100 has a decimal on top. Multiply the top and the bottom by 10 to clear it.
You get 125/1000. Divide the top and the bottom by 125.

solution.methodName: Percent to fraction: put it over 100, then simplify

steps.why: Multiplying the top and the bottom by the same number keeps the value the same.
125 × 8 = 1000. If that is hard to see, divide by 5 three times: 125/1000 → 25/200 → 5/40 → 1/8.

trapNotes.5/4: This multiplies only the top by 10 (125/100). Multiply the top and the bottom by the same number.
trapNotes.1/80: This multiplies only the bottom by 10 (12.5/1000). Multiply the top and the bottom by the same number.
trapNotes.25/2: This is 12.5 written as a fraction. It forgets that percent means "out of 100", so it never divides by 100.
